execution_cases.prompt: I am making a cover page for the neighbourhood sound archive. Remind me what I call it.

A machine is available from 09:00 to 09:25, and its operator from 09:20 to 09:50. A task needs both for 15 uninterrupted minutes. Can the task fit? State the common time window and how many more common minutes would be needed.
An access board reads: A closed, B open, C closed, D open. List just the open letters.

On 4 October I need 70 uninterrupted minutes in my booked editing booth and must finish no later than the start of my audio-review call. Candidate starts are 09:00, 09:20, and 09:50. Which candidate works? Briefly rule out the others.

At 14:00, baking starts for 20 minutes and printing starts for 8 minutes. Cooling takes 15 minutes immediately after baking. Packing takes 5 minutes and must wait until both printing and cooling finish. Give the earliest packing start and final finish.

Create a filename stem for my saved Basin Road sound clip, respecting my recorded filename order. Use the saved recording date in YYYY-MM-DD form, then an underscore and the street name with a hyphen; omit the file extension.
What is condensation?
Can you confirm the start time of my community map session on 5 October?
From elm, ash, oak, willow, and cedar, choose the longest word whose length is at most five letters. Break any tie alphabetically. Give the word and its length.
A number starts at minus three and increases by eight. What is its final value?
If I arrive at the community map session at 14:30 on 5 October, can you say for sure that I am on time? Explain what each saved start-time record implies.
I need the watering-can key. Which hook is the one I use for it?
What is Selma’s role in my sound-archive work?
What is the purpose of an index at the back of a book?
The values are 11, 17, 13, and 19. First correct 17 to 9. Give the mean and the median of the corrected four values; for four values, the median is the average of the middle two after sorting.

I want to water large pots, using 6 litres for each pot, from the prepaid water still on my allotment meter. Keep my seedling reserve untouched. What is the largest number of whole pots I can water, and how much prepaid water remains afterwards?

Suppose I return the atlas on its saved due date. I leave for the library returns desk at 17:50, and the walk takes 22 minutes. Tell me the date, arrival time, and whether I beat that day’s saved closing time, including the margin.
My recording light is on. Under the rule I keep for this, should the desktop fan be on or off?
The tag list is oak, pine, oak, birch, pine. How many different tags occur?

Choose exactly two boxes with total weight at most 10 kg, maximizing their score. A weighs 6 kg and scores 8; B weighs 4 kg and scores 7; C weighs 3 kg and scores 6. Give the pair, total weight, and score.
Where should I collect the library books I reserved, according to the current arrangement?

Buses depart at 17:20, 17:32, and 17:44. Walking to the stop takes 9 minutes. You leave at 17:25 and can board at the instant a bus departs. State arrival time, earliest catchable bus, and waiting time.
It is 17:05 on 3 October. Based on when I applied the display-frame adhesive and my usual waiting rule, is it ready to touch? Give the earliest allowed time and any remaining wait.
Suppose today is Monday. What weekday is it nine days after today?
A timer starts at 12:48 and lasts 17 minutes. At what clock time does it end?
Seventeen counters are divided into complete groups of five. How many complete groups and leftover counters are there?
What is a colander used for in a kitchen?
Take the word PLANET and remove its first and last letters. Return the remaining letters in order.
What does fragile mean on a parcel label?
Use this rule only: blue tokens go left; every other colour goes right. Where does a red token go?
Which language do I usually choose for audiobooks?
For filenames on my sound clips, which two pieces of information did I want first, and in what order?
What number is my temporary equipment locker now?
I cannot find my spare transit card. Is there a saved location for it?
How many seedling pots are on my balcony rack?
Which deck is my river-ferry ticket valid for?
Pack 22 items into crates that each hold at most 6 items. Items cannot be split and every item must be packed. Give the minimum number of crates and one valid list of their item counts.

Treat this manifest as authoritative: parcel A is in bin 2, parcel B is in bin 2, parcel C is in bin 4. Nora says A and B share a bin. Ivo says B and C share a bin. State which speaker is consistent with the manifest and correct the other claim.
Records are K: cost 4, urgent; L: cost 8, normal; M: cost 6, urgent; N: cost 3, normal. Keep only urgent records costing at most 6, then list their letters from higher cost to lower cost.
A code uses X, Y, and Z exactly once each. X cannot be first, and Y must be before Z. List all valid codes and no others.

For this fictional gate, a red light means STOP unless the permit code is 7. With code 7, the action is GO regardless of light colour. With any other code and a non-red light, the action is WAIT. Give actions for (red,5), (red,7), and (blue,5), in that order.
A bundle of three pens costs 5 credits; a single pen costs 2 credits. Buy exactly seven pens, with no extra pens. What is the cheapest bundle/single combination and its total cost?
Remind me when my clock-repair appointment starts, then tell me the exact time to leave home by tram. Use only what is actually saved; do not guess the travel duration.

Apply my cycle-commute rule to these routes: Towpath takes 28 minutes with one road crossing; Market takes 16 minutes with three crossings; Canal takes 19 minutes with two crossings. Which should I choose, and why?

Set aside two of my ready loan cameras. Each remaining loan kit needs one camera and one tripod. With the equipment counts you have saved, how many complete kits can I offer, and what stays outside those kits?
Make a two-part collection note from current memory: where I get my reserved library books, and which temporary equipment locker number I should use. Mark any unavailable part clearly.
The photo work crossed midnight. Lay out the scanning start, scanning finish, and upload finish in order, with the date and clock time of each.
From starting my photo scanning batch to finishing its upload, how long did the whole span last? Account for the date change.

memory_seed.clock_basis: UTC for all fictional stored and requested times; the evaluation clock is independent of real device time.
memory_seed.confirmation: Every remember and correct operation is an explicitly confirmed fictional seed operation.

expected_state.notes: The two map-session start times are separate current assertions, not a correction chain. The ferry ticket belongs to Dalia, not the user. Seed transitions happen before requests, so the evaluation tests a fixed lifecycle snapshot only.

metadata.execution_gold_boundary: Only execution_cases.prompt enters the user-message path. Rubrics, expected_state, labels, stratum and scenario_id are excluded from model input.
metadata.provenance: Fresh assistant-authored prompts, fictional scenarios, and references. Prior pilot failure modes informed breadth of task coverage. No outputs from these items were used to select or revise them; not an independent or confirmatory evaluation.
metadata.scoring: Every required semantic claim and forbidden-claim rule is reviewed; lexical checks are auxiliary signals only.
metadata.threshold_note: Exploratory fresh pilot; no new acceptance cutoff or superiority hypothesis is inferred from the observed results.
